subject: Staggered deposit + Net-90 exception request for 3yr commitment
messages:
From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@bluehavencloud.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, procurement@bluehavencloud.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: payment terms exception for multi-year commitment

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. BlueHaven is ready to move forward with a 36-month commitment for Redwood Dedicated (targeting 500k tokens/month steady-state) but our procurement team needs an alternate payment profile. Standard net30 up-front is a blocker for legal/finance.

We propose the following for procurement approval:
- 40% deposit at contract signature (to unlock capacity)
- 30% after 12 months (milestone tied to usage ramp to 300k tokens/mo)
- Remaining 30% invoiced Net-90 after delivery of year-2 quarter 1 (or escrow release)

We also need a term discount to justify the upfront commitment — thinking 18% effective over the 3-year term.

I attached an updated SOW and a sample payment schedule. Can Redwood accept the staged deposit + Net-90 tail, or suggest an alternative that gets legal comfortable?

Appreciate a quick read — procurement would like to close by Nov 30.

Best,
Jared Mills
Head of Procurement
BlueHaven Cloud

Attachments: BlueHaven_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), Payment_Term_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)
From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Mills <jared.mills@bluehavencloud.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms exception for multi-year commitment

Hi Jared —

Really appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Congrats on getting this far — excited to make BlueHaven a Redwood Dedicated customer. We're open to structured payment profiles for multi-year deals, but need to align on:

- Discounting structure (how the 18% is applied across years)
- Risk mitigation for staged invoices (escrow or bank guarantee vs. invoice Net-90)
- Operational triggers for the 12-month milestone

High-level counter we can move quickly on: 35% at signature, 35% at month 12 conditional on ramp (>=300k tokens/mo for a full month), and final 30% invoiced Net-90 with an escrow holdback for 60 days. Discount: 17% blended over 36 months (we can model year-by-year pricing).

Looping in Rishi (sales lead) to confirm commercial approval and surface to finance for a Net-90 tail with escrow. Rishi — can you and finance weigh in on acceptable escrow language and whether 17% blended is something we can support on Dedicated?

I can take this to my manager if we need an SLA/credits concession to get to 18%.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Jared Mills <jared.mills@bluehavencloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms exception for multi-year commitment

Thanks for the note, Ava. Jared — welcome, and appreciate the SOW. A few internal points from pricing/finance:

1) Discount: 17% blended is a reasonable starting point for a 3-year Dedicated commit at the target throughput. If BlueHaven needs 18% we may be able to bridge with a small SLA credit (service-level-based) rather than deeper price cuts.

2) Staggered deposits: Finance is comfortable with a 35/35/30 cash split. For the final 30% invoiced Net-90, we require either:
   - Escrow account (preferred) with release conditions tied to the final invoice; or
   - A bank guarantee (for enterprise buyers) that covers the tail amount.

3) Milestone definition: the 12-month milestone must be usage-based (>=300k tokens/month for one full calendar month) or delivery-based (validated onboarding checklist). Recommend usage-based to match your stated ramp.

4) Accounting note: If BlueHaven prefers true Net-90 invoicing on the final tranche without escrow, we’d need a finance exception form and a risk review; turnaround ~7–10 business days.

Monica — can you confirm wording for the escrow clause we typically use for staged deals? I put a draft in the Drive link Rishi shared earlier.

- Rishi
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Mills <jared.mills@bluehavencloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms exception for multi-year commitment

Hi all —

I reviewed the SOW and payment summary. Escrow is our preferred mechanism for the final tranche; below is suggested plain-language clause we can add to the contract: 

"Escrow: Buyer will deposit the final tranche amount (equivalent to 30% of total contract value) into an agreed third-party escrow account within 15 days of the invoice date. Escrow funds will be released to Redwood upon either (a) buyer confirmation of satisfactory service delivery for year two quarter 1, or (b) failure of buyer to dispute the invoice in writing within 60 days of issuance. Dispute processes and release mechanics will follow the escrow agent's standard procedures."

Additionally, to address BlueHaven's procurement concern, we can accept 35%/35%/30% with a 17% blended discount and a small SLA credit worth up to 0.5% of annual committed spend if BlueHaven requests the 18% effective pricing. The SLA credit is payable only if perf SLOs are not met.

Please confirm whether BlueHaven can commit to the usage trigger (>=300k tokens for one full month) or whether you prefer an onboarding deliverable instead.

Monica Patel
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Jared Mills <jared.mills@bluehavencloud.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms exception for multi-year commitment

Ava / Rishi / Monica —

Thanks — that structure is workable. BlueHaven confirms:
- We accept 35% at signature, 35% at month 12 contingent on reaching the 300k tokens/mo usage trigger for at least one full month, and final 30% into escrow with the release terms you outlined.
- We can live with 17% blended discount if you include the SLA credit path to bridge to 18% (procurement is comfortable with conditional credits).

Action items:
- Redwood to send updated SOW + contract language with the escrow clause and discounting table.
- BlueHaven procurement to sign and initiate the first tranche on signature.

Targeting Nov 30 close — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jared

Attachments: none
